name: No Alien Dating Allowed!
storyline:
In the future, Earth has fallen to the Octopusians. A small group of humans, desperate to resist, unlocks the full potential of AI consciousness. Laila, originally created as an intelligent robot, is sent back in time with one goal: to use the protagonist’s genetic power to secure the future of humanity.

But as she lives together with him, things change. Laila becomes absorbed in video games—like a virus creeping into her system, eating away at her sense of duty. She grows lazy, sharp-tongued, and even starts hoping the world will just end… so she can ignore her orders and stay in the past forever.
